basic_details.job_title: Assam Allied and Healthcare Council Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 22 Part Time Members Posts
basic_details.short_information: Assam Allied and Healthcare Council (AAHC) has officially released the Part Time Members Recruitment 2026 notification (Advt. No. DME/AAHC/2026/87) for 22 vacancies across Assam. Eligible candidates with a Postgraduate, Graduate, or Diploma qualification along with 10 years of relevant experience, aged below 60 years as on 1st January 2026, can submit their offline applications up to 08 August 2026 through the prescribed application form available on the official portal https://dme.assam.gov.in/. Selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Assam Allied and Healthcare Council Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.dmeassam.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assam Allied and Healthcare Council Part Time Members posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Assam Allied and Healthcare Council Part Time Members posts is 08-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Part Time Members?
faq.answer: There are a total of 22 vacancies for the Part Time Members posts in the Assam Allied and Healthcare Council recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Diploma, Graduate, or Postgraduate degree along with 10 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Part Time Members positions?
faq.answer: Candidates should be below 60 years of age as on 1st January, 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 2,000/- for all categories, payable via a crossed bank draft.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application process is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these Part Time Members positions?
faq.answer: These positions are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only permanent residents of Assam who meet the qualification and age criteria are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Director of Medical Education, Assam (www.dmeassam.gov.in).

faq.question: Q10. To whom should the application be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be forwarded to the Chairperson, Assam Allied and Healthcare Council, Office of the Director of Medical Education, Six mile, Khanapara, Guwahati - 781022.
